## Creando gráficas

```{r echo=F, warning=F, message=F}
library(ggplot2)
library(palmerpenguins)

plot <- ggplot(data=penguins,
               aes(x=flipper_length_mm,
                   y=body_mass_g)) +
  geom_point(aes(color=species,
                 shape=species))

plot

```
